Name: Aster's Beam and Kitchen Mod for Farm Building Interiors
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[center][size=4][u][b]JUNE 2026 NOTICE:[/b][/u] This mod has been updated to be 1.6 compatible and using the latest Content Patcher format/features. Please do a CLEAN INSTALL when updating to v.2.0.0![/size][/center]

[u][b][size=4]Description[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]This mod allows you to change colors of the following features in interior maps: [b]interior beams, stairs, log panels, interior pillars, and wainscoting[/b]. [/size]Additional features include recolors and new styles for [b]crib and kitchen[/b].[/*]
[*][size=3]Lots of options, [b]in over 16 colors[/b]! [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]This mod is fully configurable, so [b]you can enable/disable changes individually and choose where you want those changes to happen[/b]. This is great for compatibility with other mods and [/size]also means, for example, you can have a farmhouse and island farmhouse interior that look very different from one another.[/*]
[*]Modular recolor available for the following interiors: [b]farmhouse, cabin, cellar, island farmhouse, greenhouse, and shed.[/b][/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]Features[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b](NEW! in v2.0.0) Enable/Disable Mod: [/b]You can deactivate all patches in this mod mid-game, removing the need to reload the game if you don't want to use this mod or to deactivate this mod outside the game when another interior recolor mod is installed. [/*]
[*][b](NEW! in v2.0.0) Auto vs. Modular Recolor Modes[/b]: [b]Auto [/b]mode applies a one-size-fits-all recolor for every interior map in the game. It works as a 'base' recolor, whereas [b]Modular [/b]mode lets you further specify the styles in certain farm building interiors, [b]applying these patches on top of Auto mode's patches.[/b][/*]
[*][b](NEW! in v2.0.0) Separate toggles for every farm building interior: [/b]You can pick and choose to Enable/Disable modular mode recolors for every individual farm building interior that is edited by this mod.[/*]
[*][b]Fine Beams: [/b]Toggle between the default vanilla interior beam width and the thinner version available in this mod.[/*]
[/list][u][b][size=4]Config Guide[/size][/b][/u]
Due to the amount of config settings, especially in Modular mode, not every single setting will be described in detail in this section; this is just a summary. [b]ALWAYS READ THE CONFIG DESCRIPTION PROVIDED IN-GAME. USING [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED FOR THIS MOD.[/b]

[b][u]Basic Features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod: [/b]What it says on the tin. Default [i]true. [/i]If [i]false, [/i]disables ALL patches applicable by this mod.[/*]
[*][b]Recolor Mode: [/b]Toggles whether the recolors apply automatically to all interior beams or use a modular mode with manual input for each location/element. Default [i]Auto.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Fine Beams: [/b]Toggles between vanilla interior beam with and thinner beams provided by this mod. Default [i]false.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Enable Log Panels: [/b]Enables the unique interior log panel designs provided by this mod - further configurable in each location's Log Panel Style/Color config settings below. Default [i]false.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Auto Beams Recolor: [/b]Toggles color palette for interiors. Applies the same color palette to ALL interior features (beams, stairs, log panels, wainscoting, pillars) in ALL interior maps. Default [i]Vanilla. [/i]Set to [i]Off [/i]if you want to use another interior recolor mod as the 'base' color, or for this mod to not affect anything other than farm building interiors.[/*]
[/list][b][u]Crib/Kitchen Features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Crib/Kitchen Recolor: [/b]Toggles ALL patches for crib/kitchen. ALL subsequent configs in this section WILL NOT APPLY if this one is set to [i]false.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Crib/Kitchen Recolor: [/b]Choose the color palette for crib/kitchen. Some recolor settings depend on the Style setting below.[/*]
[*][b]Kitchen Style: [/b]Choose the kitchen style available in this mod.[/*]
[/list][b][u]Modular Mode Features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Modular mode is available for the following interior locations: [b]FarmHouse, Cabin, Cellar, IslandFarmHouse, Greenhouse, Shed.[/b][/*]
[*]When Modular mode is chosen, every single recolor config under each interior location type will be applied [b]ON TOP OF the color you chose for Auto Beams Recolor. [/b]Essentially, Auto Beams Recolor is the 'base' color patch for this mod.[/*]
[*][b]Enable (Location) Recolor: [/b]Toggles ALL patches for the specified location. ALL subsequent configs in each section WILL NOT APPLY if this one is set to [i]false.[/i][/*]
[*][b](Location) Beams Recolor: [/b]Choose the interior beam color for the specified location.[/*]
[*][b](Location) Log Panel/Stairs/Pillar Color: [/b]Choose the color for the specified interior feature for the specified location.[/*]
[*][b](Location) Log Wainscoting/Log Panel/Pillar Style: [/b]Choose the style for the specified interior feature for the specified location that is available in this mod.[/*]
[/list][u][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and the latest version of [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip [i]"[CP] Aster's Beam Mod - Update 2.0.0" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Configure away and have fun![/*]
[/list][u][b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*][b]THIS MOD IS UNTESTED AND MAY BE INCOMPATIBLE WITH MOBILE. Compatibility for mobile will not be provided and requests for such disregarded.[/b][/*]
[*][b](NEW! in v2.0.0)[/b] Due to modular features and the option to enable/disable the patches provided by this mod in-game, this mod can be installed concurrently with other recolor mods.[/*]
[*][b](NEW! in v2.0.0)[/b] The patches are also applied early/with low priority, so (hopefully) they will be overridden in case you forget to disable this mod's patches.[/*]
[*][b](NEW! in v2.0.0) [/b]Due to the changes in this mod's patch structure and application, [b]THIS MOD IS NOW COMPATIBLE WITH ROOMS CREATED FOR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url].[/b][/*]
[*]You can even use this mod [i]with[/i] other kitchen and interior mods, and have a different kitchen in your different buildings, or different beams from the town interiors. Pierre's can be bright pink while you use this mod to keep your farmhouse nice and gothic.[/*]
[*]Can only cause visual errors due to mod incompatibilities, not game breaking ones.[/*]
[/list][u][size=4][b]Built-In Compatibility with Other Mods:[/b][/size][/u]
[list]
[*][b](NEW! in v2.0.0) [/b]Added [b]OakSaloon [/b]palette compatibility and failsafes for crystalinerose's [b]Cozy Rustic Interior Suite, [/b]plus compatibility for [b]Cozy Rustic Greenhouse [/b]and future entries in the Cozy Rustic series[b].[/b]﻿[/*]
[/list][u][size=4][b]Art Credit:[/b][/size][/u]
Big thanks to everyone who's given their permission to add their art to this mod! Permission from each of the people listed below has been asked and received in order to be allowed to receive DP from this mod.
[list]
[*]Some of the wood panel art and colour palettes come from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11168]Krissymarie's Woods Wainscotting Walls and Floors mod[/url]﻿. This mod was initially designed to complement that one so if you like this one go give that one some love! There is also an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9869]Alternatives Textures conversion[/url]﻿﻿. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Additional Credit:[/b][/size]
This mod's code and file structure has been updated and is currently maintained by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/crystalinerose]Kisaa (crystalinerose)[/url][b]. [/b]The original assets are unmodified except some rearranging to reduce amount of patches.
[list]
[*]I (Kisaa) would like to thank Aster as the original author of this mod for giving me the permission to do so and to add compatibility with my released and upcoming mods.[/*]
[*]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]Airyn [/url]for once again being the master of dynamic tokens and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/aviroen]Aviroen[/url] for rubberducking and enabling my local token crimes. Without them I would not be as powerful and efficient at committing the token crimes in question.[/*]
[/list]
